description: Nominal-path diagnostic baseline; does not execute the complete manuscript Sec. III-B–IV pipeline or measured-force hybrid control. Three Panda arms realize link-aware contracted contacts: base grasp, base support and internal-link manipulation. The complete articulated object has an unactuated free root and passive internal hinge/slider. No world hinge, object actuator or pose forcing. Dense source samples and functional group labels are synthetic supplied inputs; geometric contraction and target coupled realization are executed.
